episodes.synopsis: Issei is back with Rias and Asia living in his house, and Kiba starts acting weird when he sees a picture of a holy sword at Issei's house.
episodes.title: Another Disquieting Premonition!

episodes.synopsis: Issei gets another warning about the white dragon, and church followers bearing Holy Swords pay a visit to the devils.
episodes.title: The Holy Sword Is Here!

episodes.synopsis: Issei and Kiba fight the Xenovia and Irina, and Issei tries to deal with the consequences of their fight.
episodes.title: I'll Destroy the Holy Sword!

episodes.synopsis: Issei and the others team up with the church to fight Freed, but an even greater enemy appears.
episodes.title: A Strong Enemy Appeared!

episodes.synopsis: The Kuoh Academy students fight Kokabiel and his minions to defend their school and their town.
episodes.title: Decisive Battle at Kuoh Academy!

episodes.synopsis: The Occult Research Club fights Kokabiel and learns some shocking truths about the power struggle between the angels, fallen angels, and devils.
episodes.title: Go! Occult Research Club!

episodes.synopsis: The Occult Research Club takes over cleaning the pool to thank the student council for their help with Kokabiel, and Issei runs into a lot of trouble.
episodes.title: Summer! Bathing Suits! I'm in Trouble!

episodes.synopsis: Issei learns more about the feud between the Twin Sky Dragons and Rias and Sona have to deal with troublesome family members at Open House.
episodes.title: Open House Begins!

episodes.synopsis: The other Bishop of the House of Gremory is released, and Akeno takes Issei to meet a new acquaintance.
episodes.title: I Have a Junior!

episodes.synopsis: Issei meets Michael, the Chief of the Angels, and continues training Gasper in the days leading up to the Leaders' Summit.
episodes.title: Various Three-way Deadlocks!

episodes.synopsis: Time stops during the Leaders' Summit, and Issei and the others meet a new enemy.
episodes.title: The Leaders' Summit Begins!

episodes.synopsis: Issei battles Vali and discovers hidden depths to his power as the Twin Sky Dragons face off.
episodes.title: Clash of the Twin Sky Dragons!
